description: This file contains the implementation of the Days360 class, which provides a method for calculating the number of days between two dates based on a 360-day year, used in financial and accounting calculations within the PhpSpreadsheet calculation library.

classes.name: Days360
classes.description: Provides static methods to calculate the number of days between two dates based on a 360-day calendar, supporting both US and European methods.

methods.name: between
methods.description: Calculates the number of days between two dates using a 360-day year, supporting array inputs for batch processing.

methods.name: dateDiff360
methods.description: Performs the core calculation of the days difference based on date parts and method (US or European).

methods.name: getStartDay
methods.description: Adjusts the start day according to the 360-day calendar rules, especially handling end-of-month scenarios.

methods.name: getEndDay
methods.description: Adjusts the end day based on the method and end-of-month conditions, handling month rollover.
